name: ticket-triage
description: Guided build for a support and IT ticket triage pipeline on tickets already in Snowflake. Classifies each ticket into category, priority and resolver queue with Cortex AI functions against a customer-owned taxonomy, extracts product, error and asset entities, links duplicates and known issues with embeddings, and identifies deflection candidates with suggested resolutions grounded in a Cortex Search knowledge base and cited back to source articles. Measures routing precision, recall and macro-F1 per queue, a priority confusion matrix and deflection precision against a labeled answer key, and produces a value readout for routing time, MTTR and deflection from customer-supplied unit economics.
